decision.name: CLOSE_HANDOFF_ONLY_GATE_AND_ISOLATE_RUNNER_ARCHIVE_TO_HANDOFF_MISMATCH
decision.finding: Fresh public commit delegates handoff._is_context_only to evidence_health._is_context_only and adds nine-case dedicated handoff regression; handoff-only parity is now covered by bounded executor PASS. runner._scoring_history still uses bool(dict(obs.provenance).get('context_only',False)), so string ' false ' is dropped from scoring while handoff/evidence_health treat it as scoring, and explicit None/''/[] enter scoring while handoff/evidence_health treat them as context.
